message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV file and user-submitted comment directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, value-range guards, or structural validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: The data is loaded from a local file path (DATA_PATH) with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks, and no remote source fetching is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only applies LabelEncoder to the emotion column without any validation of label values against an expected set, distribution comparison, or label-noise detection.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing pipeline applies only standard NLP transformations (lowercasing, decontraction, punctuation removal, stopword removal, lemmatization) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The model is loaded from disk via pickle.load() in update_record() without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; no integrity verification is performed before deserialization.
No detected label distribution validation: No class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection is performed before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied during training.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split is performed, the evaluation score is neither signed/hashed nor logged with integrity checks, and only a single metric (macro F1) is computed without any isolation or tamper-proof storage of the held-out set.
No detected input sanitization: The POST handler directly extracts 'comment' from the request JSON and passes it to the model pipeline without any validation of type, length, shape, or content.

No detected output bounds checks: The predicted probabilities from model.predict_proba are used directly without any NaN checks, bounds validation, or sanity checks on the output values before returning them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a classical text-classification model (Naive Bayes), not an LLM, so prompt injection is not applicable; no such defenses are present or needed.
